parameters.help_en: The unique identifier used to ensure request idempotence. When creating or updating a resource, if you send multiple requests with the same ClientToken, the system treats them as the same operation, preventing duplicate creation or updates. The ClientToken is generated by the client. Use the same ClientToken for retries
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求幂等性的唯一标识。在创建或更新资源时，如果多次使用相同的 ClientToken 发起请求，系统会将其视为同一次操作，从而避免重复创建或更新。ClientToken 由客户端生成，建议在重试场景中使用相同的 ClientToken
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API MCP Core service that was successfully created
parameters.help_zh: 创建成功的 API MCP Core 服务 ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role to assume in the target account when performing cross-account operations with multi-account access enabled
parameters.help_zh: 开启多账号访问进行跨账号操作时，扮演的目标账号 RAM角色名称
parameters.name: assume_role_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-account access
parameters.name: enable_assume_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable a custom VPC whitelist. If this feature is not enabled, the account-level configuration is used
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自定义VPC白名单，不开启则跟随账户级别的配置
parameters.name: enable_custom_vpc_whitelist

parameters.help_en:
The custom OAuth Client ID when a custom OAuth configuration is selected.

`Only Web/Native applications are supported, and the OAuth scope must include /acs/mcp-server`
parameters.help_zh:
选择自定义OAuth配置时的自定义OAuth Client ID。

`仅支持 Web/Native 应用，且 OAuth 范围必须包含 /acs/mcp-server`
parameters.name: oauth_client_id

parameters.help_en:
The public network access type: allow public access, disallow public access, or inherit account configuration.
`public` (enabled), `private` (disabled), `inherit` (inherit account configuration)
parameters.help_zh:
公网访问类型：允许公网访问、不允许公网访问、继承账号配置。
`public`（开启）, `private`（关闭）, `inherit`（跟随账号配置）
parameters.name: public_access_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC whitelist entries. Each value is a source VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_whitelists
